purpose: Authorize one empirical opening of nucleotide identity for the exact fresh host-resource relational TTF design after response-blind mask filtering and exact survivor-geometry synthetic requalification passed.

species.roles: inherit the response-blind host-resource design; no resplitting; only survivor-supported targets with >=5 surviving sources enter the estimand

response_contract.panel_selection: largest exact unique locality count, then larger aligned header count, then lexicographic raw locus identifier; fixed before identity
response_contract.sequence_pair_distance: uncorrected p-distance = canonical A/C/G/T mismatches / jointly canonical columns
response_contract.valid_sequence_pair: jointly canonical columns >= ceil(0.50 * frozen alignment length)
response_contract.locality_pair_distance: arithmetic mean over all valid cross-locality sequence-pair p-distances
response_contract.edge_response: locality-pair distance on the unchanged frozen density-scaled kNN edge
response_contract.source_training_response: post-IBD turnover rank orthogonalized against within-source edge-length rank
response_contract.source_to_target_score: Spearman correlation of the source-only TTF field prediction with target post-IBD turnover

relational_model.covariance: two-way source/target cluster-robust sandwich with dyad intersection subtraction and finite-cluster corrections
relational_model.null_decision: otherwise RELATIONAL_HOST_RESOURCE_NULL_WITH_QUALIFIED_POWER; the formal survivor synthetic power gate has already passed

interpretation.positive: Among the frozen fresh Lepidoptera dyads, species facing more similar larval host-resource landscapes show greater transfer of post-IBD spatial genetic structure after geographic opportunity, broad family membership, source quality, target predictability, and sampling-geometry mismatch are controlled.
interpretation.null: Under qualified power, the frozen host-resource relation does not explain source-target transfer heterogeneity in the tested Lepidoptera design.
interpretation.limits: Neither branch rewrites the completed unconditional TTF result; this is a new prospective relational hypothesis.

one_shot_rules: Open identity only for the 402 species in the frozen empirical union.
Do not add or drop species, dyads, host covariates, controls, or taxonomic groups after opening.
Do not change p-distance, IBD residualization, bandwidth, prior, segment points, source-only field definition, covariance, alpha, or decision rule after opening.
Do not select a favorable host-overlap threshold or alternative ecological relation from the empirical result.
Do not use the empirical result to rescue or reinterpret the completed unconditional TTF result or failed conditional-order deployment.
